title: A Social Signal Research Stack for AI Builders
summary: How to combine last30days, official docs, GitHub activity, and evaluation notes before building on a trend.
author: OpenAgent.bot Editors
seoTitle: Social Signal Research Stack for AI Builders
seoDescription: A practical stack for AI builders researching recent market, community, GitHub, and social signals before building.
body: AI builders move fast, but the market moves faster. A useful research stack should tell you what people are actually trying, where they are stuck, and which projects are gaining real attention.
Start with [last30days](/skills/last30days-skill) for recent social and developer signal. Then check official repositories, docs, and evaluation artifacts before making a product decision.
- Source of truth: official docs and GitHub repositories.
- Evaluation notes: write down task, source, evidence, and uncertainty.
- Follow-up: rerun the same query after a week if the topic is moving quickly.
Upvotes, likes, transcripts, comments, issues, pull requests, release notes, and prediction-market odds all say different things. Treat them as evidence, not verdicts.
Use this stack before writing a comparison blog, adding a project to a directory, deciding which open-source tool to try, or choosing what to build next.
